description: Sends a request for a written ELC Conference 2027 partnership offer to the ELC team, with the chosen package and add-ons. The only tool that takes contact details — call it only after the user agreed to send their name, email and company. If the request could not be delivered it says NOT SENT and returns the quote, a book-a-call link and an email address instead.

addons.description: Add-ons to include, optional. One or more of: category-exclusivity, roundtable, partner-workshop.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

email.description: Required. Work email the offer goes to.

message.description: Anything the team should know: goals, timing, questions. Optional.

name.description: Required. Full name of the person asking.

package.description: Required. The package the offer is for. One of: luminary, navigator, pioneer.

name: request_partnership_offer
title: Request a written partnership offer
